skill.name: Custom File Output with Object Serialization
skill.description: Implements custom file output using FileOutputFormat base class with pluggable object-to-bytes conversion logic. Enables writing DataStream elements to files when standard serialization formats are insufficient or non-standard encoding is required.
skill.skill_body:
Extend FileOutputFormat and override the write method to implement custom object-to-bytes conversion. Register the custom format via writeUsingOutputFormat() on the DataStream. Ensure the serialization logic handles the target data type and file encoding requirements.

## Objective

Write DataStream elements to files with custom serialization
## Applicable Signals

- DataStream contains objects with non-standard serialization requirements
- File output target requires custom encoding
- Built-in sink formats do not support the data structure

## Contraindications

- Standard Parquet, Avro, or JSON serialization is adequate
- FileSink with built-in formats is sufficient for the use case
- Exactly-once delivery semantics required without custom checkpointing support

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Create a class extending FileOutputFormat<T>', 'detail': 'Define the generic type T matching the DataStream element type'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Implement the write(T record) method', 'detail': 'Convert the record object to bytes using custom logic and write to the output stream'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Register the custom format on the DataStream', 'detail': 'Call dataStream.writeUsingOutputFormat(new CustomFileOutputFormat())'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Verify file output and serialization correctness', 'detail': 'Test with sample data to ensure bytes are written as expected'}

## Constraints

- FileOutputFormat subclass must implement custom write logic
- Object-to-bytes conversion must be deterministic and thread-safe
- File system must be accessible and writable from all task managers

## Cautions

- Custom serialization logic is responsible for data integrity; test thoroughly with edge cases
- For exactly-once delivery guarantees, ensure the custom implementation participates in Flink checkpointing

## Output Contract

- FileOutputFormat subclass implemented with custom write logic; elements serialized and persisted to file system; caller receives confirmation of successful file write or exception on failure

## Example Executions

### Example 1

- Input: DataStream<CustomObject> stream with non-standard fields
- Output: File containing serialized CustomObject instances in custom binary format
- Notes: Custom write() method converts each CustomObject to bytes before file persistence
